description: Use this when the person says they are 18 or over and wants to keep their progress, or when another tool says it needs the adult tap. No 2hives sign-in is needed. It returns a tap token to pass to the tools that take one; never call it on your own. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not before the user has tapped; listening never needs it.

adult_confirmed.description: True when the person confirmed they are 18 or over. Required on this host.

confirm.description: True when the person said yes, keep my progress.
